notes.title: [Dev Note] To the Minesweeper Veterans
notes.content: [p]30 years ago, when I fired up Minesweeper on a toasty 486 PC running Windows 3.2, I was instantly hooked by those hypnotic numbers and hidden dangers. That grid of tiles felt like a portal to a digital mystery—each click held brain-tickling secrets. Like many computer newbies back then, I’d rage-quit over impossible 50/50 guesses (RIP, mouse), but also fist-pump the air when logic cracked the code.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611542/2a83c106f60e06454675cdb531a5c3b87b76b3d0.jpg"][/img]But over time, something felt… missing. Minesweeper—this stone-cold classic—got stranded like a relic on the lonely shores of offline Windows. Heck, you can’t even find it on modern Windows anymore![/p][p]Over the years, I tried countless variants: Classic, No-Guess, Puzzle modes… Yet, like fading pixels, the player base shrank. For all its genius design—a masterpiece of rules and randomness—modern gamers found it too punishing, too thinky, too aimless.[/p][p][/p][p]Newcomers might wonder why we’d obsessively click tiles for hours. Maybe only us veterans still sigh: “Games today are all flash—only Minesweeper lets me focus.”[/p][p][/p][p]So, inspired by the greats, we took a leap: introducing Minesweeper Big Bomb! It flips the script—hunt the mines, trigger the booms, savor the explosive thrills! Even Classic mode gets a twist with power-ups, letting rookies scale the learning curve and taste that sweet, sweet logic rush.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611542/47f4316e7d0a97cae2def7ff1f2c3b83dd339315.png"][/img][/p][p]Purists may grumble—“Sacrilege!”—but hey, classic Minesweeper isn’t going anywhere. Why not shake things up? When your first bomb erupts, you might just hear an echo of that furious desk slam from a ’94 computer lab… synced perfectly with your racing heartbeat.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611542/4f19e0593970ba5cb4df3b5ffc72652aca2c7cab.png"][/img]At the end of the day, we hope Minesweeper Big Bomb welcomes new players and rekindles the love for veterans. Come rediscover the timeless joy of digital deduction![/p][p][/p][p]To the Minesweeper Veterans[/p]

notes.title: "Minesweeper Big Bomb" is now live on Steam! Add it to your Wishlist now!
notes.content:
Minesweeper, Reimagined！ Experience original Big Bomb Mode + classic minesweeper gameplay, offering dual logic deduction experiences! Enjoy quirky power-ups and collect various skins/achievements! [b]Add it to your Wishlist now![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611542/4f19e0593970ba5cb4df3b5ffc72652aca2c7cab.png[/img]

[b]Game Features:[/b]

Easy to learn, multiple modes, achievement collection – a brand-new minesweeper with endless challenges

Two distinct gameplay styles, each with dozens of difficulty levels

Innovative Big Bomb Mode: Reverse logic – detonate all mines this time!

Diverse power-ups: New players can use items to conquer challenges

Customizable skins: Collect and mix mine markers, flags, tiles and more

Advanced trials: Complete badge challenges like no-retry runs, item-free clears, blind sweeps

Earn coins by clearing stages to buy skins or revive in-game

Extreme challenges, historical records, personal achievements await!
